data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, you are used to fighting the forces of evil. You gain a +%1 sacred bonus on caster level checks to overcome the spell resistance of outsiders with the chaotic or evil subtypes. These bonuses stack against outsiders who are both chaotic and evil (+%2). If you don't have the ability to cast spells, you instead gain the ability to use protection from chaos/evil as a spell-like ability three times per day.|1+min(5,TL/4)|2*(1+min(5,TL/4))
